notes: Windows Shortcut Icon Refresh: fixes existing Agent City desktop shortcuts that can remain stuck on the generic white-paper icon after the official ICO arrives. The shortcut installer now supports a silent refresh mode, re-saves Agent City.lnk against static/assets/app/agent-city.ico, and notifies Explorer that shell icon metadata changed. The new launcher automatically performs this refresh when resuming after a managed update, so upgrading from v0.9.23 to v0.9.24 repairs the existing shortcut without a manual reinstall. Tray behavior and all Simulation/Memory/Communication authority remain unchanged.
